title: Sales discount escrow + staged approval gates for strategic enterprise deals
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Summary: Build a defensible, auditable discount 'escrow' and staged approval gate flow for large enterprise deals (> $250k ARR) to reduce margin leakage and speed up approvals for high-priority strategic accounts. Goals: 1) centralize exception approvals and reduce ad-hoc email approvals; 2) make discounting predictable with guardrails and automated expiration; 3) create an audit trail for legal/finance/security questionnaires. Scope: Sales-side controls (discount request template, Slack + Salesforce integration), a lightweight approval UI for Ops/Finance, and a pricebook addendum that supports time-limited or performance-based concessions. Out of scope: full CPQ integration (will be follow-up), changes to standard self-service pricing tiers.
acceptance_criteria: Sales reps can submit a structured discount request capturing ARR, duration, rationale, and customer-risk markers
Ops/Finance approvers receive the request and can approve/decline with a single click and optional conditional clauses
Approved discounts are recorded in the Pricebook as temporary overridden rates with expiration metadata
A downloadable approval PDF (signed metadata + rationale) is available for contract attachments and security questionnaires
Integration points documented (Salesforce case, internal Slack channel, Confluence adopt guide) and a runbook for escalations
proposed_flow: 1) Sales submits discount request via form (SFDC quick action or internal portal). 2) System evaluates against auto-guardrails (thresholds: % discount, contract term, product bundles). 3) If within guardrails, auto-approve and create escrow entry in pricebook with TTL. 4) If outside guardrails, route to staged approvers: Sales Manager -> Finance Ops -> CRO (if > 40% or > $1M impact). 5) Approver can attach conditions (pilot, escrowed credits, usage-based clawback). 6) Upon approval, backend generates approval artifact and updates Salesforce opportunity and pricebook export.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (4 weeks): build request form + guardrail rules + simple approver UI; pilot with 3 strategic AEs and Finance Ops. Phase 2 (2 weeks): add Salesforce integration, PDF artifact generation, and pricebook override API. Phase 3 (2 weeks): expand to global sales org, training sessions, update pricing SOPs. Communication: internal webinar, Confluence guide, new entry in Deal Desk documentation. Metrics: approval turnaround time, % of deals with temporary overrides, and realized discount impact on ARR.
risks: Sales bypassing the flow via manual contracts (mitigation: exec sponsorship + quota credit policy)
Misconfigured guardrails causing false auto-approvals (mitigation: conservative default thresholds + monitoring)
Pricebook sync bugs leading to billing mismatches (mitigation: pre-release reconciliation checks and billing validation job)
Long approval chains slowing deal velocity (mitigation: SLA escalation and temporary auto-approve for high-priority accounts with CFO sign-off)
links: Related Linear: PM-14800 (pricing governance umbrella), ENG-12412 (pricebook API)
